status: proposed interface only; no production detector implemented
input: current RGB image plus optional past RGB for separately validated association; never simulator mask, coordinates, robot_obs or future frames

instance_fields.instance_id: assigned only by validated image association; uncertain identity remains unknown
instance_fields.localization_state: localized / partially_localized / unknown; unknown does not mean absent
instance_fields.bbox: RGB-derived tight visible box or null
instance_fields.visible_mask: RGB-predicted visible parts or null; human masks allowed only as training/evaluation labels
instance_fields.part_visibility: which drawer structures / gripper fingers are observed; no hidden-part completion
instance_fields.localization_score: requires held-out calibration; cosine alone not confidence
instance_fields.feature: same frozen DINO384 local-crop descriptor per view plus validity mask, or null
instance_fields.pixel_geometry: image-normalized box/part geometry; no metric3D claim

node: per-instance per-view local descriptor, visibility and type; do not silently fuse uncertain identities
edge: ordered pair of localized node descriptors + within-camera relative pixel geometry + explicit validity; no fixed-ROI endpoint fallback
scope: single-frame visual relation evidence; no guarantee of Holding force or In support
